summary: Eps 144-151 (Six-Tails Unleashed) and 170-171 are anime-original, confirmed by Wikipedia, animefillerlist and Narutopedia; the canon run 152-169 and 172-175 adapts chapters 403-450 (vols 44-48) and every one of those 22 episodes now has a full-record anchor. The re-entry is heavily re-interleaved: eps 142-143 had pulled the Taka-vs-Killer-B thread (408, 410-415) forward, so ep 152 replays Naruto's side of 403-405 (plus 416's B handover), ep 155 gathers the sage-training halves of 410-416 and pulls 419's fake-Eight-Tails reveal forward, and the invasion episodes shuffle 420/424/425/427 scenes between 157-160; from ep 161 on the map is nearly one-to-one with the manga (161->428, 162->429, 163->432, 164->434, 165->436, 166->437, 167->439, 168->442, 169->444, 172->445, 173->447, 174->449, 175->450). Twelve mid-chapter endings get explicit continue points. One repair: the manual ep-143 anchor (412) is actually 415 (the whole B fight), with an honest resume at 403. Existing ep-175 -> 450 is confirmed and enriched (only the celebration half of 450 is adapted). Surprises: ep 166 is a single chapter (437) stretched with anime-original Hinata material, and ep 175 recycles Ebisu's ch-426 monologue.

repairs.why: Adjacent to the target range. The manual 412 sits at the vol-44 boundary, but the episode runs the whole Taka-vs-B fight: Narutopedia lists chapters 411-415 and the Wikipedia season-6 synopsis ends on Amaterasu subduing B and the Kumo scouts rushing to the Raikage, which is the close of ch 415 'New Powers!!'. Full record supplied in anchors (start 411, chapters 411-415 Taka halves, vol 45) with a continue point of 403.

structure.notes: Single component (AniList 1735, eps 1-500); every source used (Narutopedia, Wikipedia seasons 6-8, animefillerguide, animefillerlist, listfist, CBR) numbers Shippuden cumulatively 1-500, so no conversions were applied. Wikipedia season 7 = eps 144-151 ('anime only season', Six-Tails Unleashed; Narutopedia files it as an anime-only arc) and season 8 = eps 152-175 (DVD title 'Two Saviours'); 152/153, 154/155 and 170/171 aired as same-day double episodes (numbering unaffected). Narutopedia's Pain's Assault arc = manga 413-453 <-> anime 152-169 + 172-175 (CBR repeats this), but the anime's re-entry eps 152-154 actually adapt 403-409, which the wiki files under the previous manga arc. Types confirmed: 144-151 filler (Wikipedia, animefillerlist, Narutopedia), 170-171 filler (Wikipedia 'anime-original', animefillerlist, Narutopedia no chapters), 152-169 and 172-175 canon (animefillerlist 'Manga Canon', Narutopedia chapters). Volumes used: v44 403-412, v45 413-422, v46 423-432, v47 433-442, v48 443-453 (context file / Wikipedia). No order-only OVAs or movies sit in this stretch (the 2009/2010 films are non-canon).

flags_for_sean: Ep 176 'Rookie Instructor Iruka' (outside range; our rows: filler) opens on two real ch-450 beats (Zetsu reports Pain's death to Tobi; Team Samui sets out) before the flashback filler; animefillerguide types it 'Mixed' (450) and Narutopedia lists chapters=450, while animefillerlist says Filler. Not corrected here (out of range, and the two 'mixed' sources share lineage); consider typing it mixed with END 450 when the Past Arc is researched.

Ep 143 repair (412 -> 415) is adjacent to, not inside, the 144-174 target; apply only if the batch is allowed to touch it. Its companion continue point (403) is deliberately lower than END because the anime pulled the Taka thread forward.

Source independence: animefillerguide and listfist reproduce Narutopedia's infobox lists verbatim (including the odd entries, e.g. ep 175 -> 426, ep 155 -> 407...419), so they are one lineage. The second, independent leg for every anchor is the Wikipedia season-8 synopsis plus chapter titles/contents (Wikipedia chapter list; Narutopedia chapter pages), not animefillerguide. A non-wiki per-episode source (reddit conversion threads, 2010 episode reviews) could not be obtained: the session's web-search budget ran out mid-task and reddit blocks unauthenticated fetches.

Ep 155 END is an interpretation (medium): Narutopedia lists fragments through 419; END was placed at 416 (last chapter whose mainline content is complete) with 417-418 montage beats and the pulled-forward 419 reveal recorded in chapters_adapted. If the verifier prefers 'highest chapter touched', it would read 419; the resume point (417) is unaffected.

Narutopedia's arc page contradicts itself on ch 450 (says the hero's welcome belongs to the Five Kage Summit in the manga while also spanning the arc to 453); irrelevant to the episode map, noted only because arc-range checks may trip on it.
